content:
😭😻🍒☺️🎉🙄😊💁
18. ✨🎂

So… apparently I’m 18 now.And honestly, I’m still waiting for someone to explain what exactly changes after 17. 😭😂

Looking at these two pictures feels a little unreal.

That tiny girl had absolutely no idea that one day she’d be standing here, turning 18, going to college, trying new things, meeting amazing people, chasing opportunities and somehow figuring life out one day at a time. 🥹❤️

And the funniest part?

Everyone keeps saying “You’re an adult now.”

Bro… I just got here. Give me a minute. 😭

But jokes apart, I’m genuinely excited for this chapter.

18 feels like a little milestone — not because I suddenly have everything figured out, but because there’s so much ahead to experience, learn, build and enjoy. ✨

So here’s to 18 🥂To new beginnings, bigger dreams, crazy experiences, good people, lots of laughter and hopefully… an internship because LinkedIn is testing my patience. 😭😂

And a big thank you to everyone who has been a part of my journey so far. ❤️

Now the important question:

What is ONE thing you think everyone should do at 18? 👀👇

I’m officially collecting advice before I mess up on my own. 😂
